title: Pantera-backed aPriori silent after one entity claims 60% of airdrop
summary: About 60% of aPriori’s APR airdrop was claimed by a single entity across 14,000 interconnected wallets, according to Bubblemaps.

title: How Pi Network’s 50M nodes could reshape the future of decentralized AI
summary: Pi is turning its giant mobile community into a distributed compute grid, testing whether AI can run on a global crowd instead of the cloud.

title: El Salvador’s latest $100M Bitcoin haul rekindles questions around IMF program
summary: El Salvador says it has bought 1,090 BTC worth over $100 million, raising questions about an IMF loan pledge to limit Bitcoin exposure and fiscal risks.

title: Mastercard taps Polygon to turn clunky crypto addresses into simple usernames
summary: Mastercard is rolling out verified, human-readable crypto aliases to self-custody wallets, using Polygon for onchain support and Mercuryo for identity verification.

title: Libra token-linked wallets pull $4M and bet big on Solana
summary: Wallets tied to the Libra token continue to draw liquidity and have purchased $61.5 million in Solana, despite asset freezes and fraud probes.

title: Grab deepens stablecoin push with StraitsX Web3 wallet and settlements
summary: Southeast Asian super app Grab’s MOU with StraitsX shifts its Web3 efforts from pilots to infrastructure, exploring a unified stablecoin settlement layer across Asia.

title: ARK Invest scoops $10M in Bullish as it hits record low amid crypto stock rout
summary: Crypto stocks plunged on Monday, with Coinbase, Marathon Digital, Riot, CleanSpark, Circle and Strategy all sliding sharply.

title: Mt. Gox moves $953M Bitcoin after 8 months, sparking market worries
summary: Mt. Gox just moved 10,608 BTC worth $953 million, its first big transfer in months, as $4 billion in creditor repayments stay delayed until October 2026.

title: Average Bitcoin ETF investor now underwater as BTC falls below $89.6K
summary: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs saw another day of heavy withdrawals, while Solana ETFs maintained an uninterrupted inflow streak since launch.

title: SEC makes no specific mention of crypto in 2026 exam priorities
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission’s latest examination priorities document didn’t mention crypto as an area of focus for the coming year, unlike in previous years.
